items.title: Holman Bill — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: It wasn‟t as commercial as, say, Guy Lombardo or Sammy Kaye, but it was definitely in that direction.

ctx.x: You didn‟t want to play xylophone?

So that went on for a while. Somewhere along there – this is when I was still in junior high school – I saw a movie featuring Kay Kyser and his College of Musical Knowledge, which was a radio program. They finally put them in a movie. I don‟t know if it was about his program or what, but the band had a lot of exposure in it. I got to see these guys in their uniforms, standing up and sitting down and doing that with their instruments. I thought, wow, that‟s pretty neat. Kay Kyser‟s band was a commercial band. It…
What were the two high schools, the junior high school and the senior high school you attended?
